title: My Dad's New Wife Told Grandpa a Janitor Doesn't Get a Say. Then Scholarship Night Began.
description:
At Sunday dinner, my dad's new wife told my grandfather that a man who mopped floors for forty-one years doesn't get a say. Sign the house over, or go to a home.

She had no idea what Grandpa did on the night shift. Or who was going to walk on stage at Scholarship Night.
